WINDOWS_SHADER_TARGET_FIX.rationale: PCD3D_ES31 (OpenGL ES 3.1) is a mobile/embedded shader platform. WindowsNoEditor desktop runtime only requires PCD3D_SM5 (DirectX 11/12 SM5) and SF_VULKAN_SM5 (Vulkan SM5). ES3.1 compilation wastes ~33% shader permutations and causes 35+ material failures that are IRRELEVANT_TARGET_ONLY or EXPECTED_FEATURE_LEVEL_EXCLUSION.
WINDOWS_SHADER_TARGET_FIX.static_test: grep '+TargetedRHIs=PCD3D_ES31' DefaultEngine.ini && echo 'FAIL: ES31 still present' || echo 'PASS: ES31 removed'
